file_metadata.author: M-Tokuni
file_metadata.precedence_note: This file defines the sole Nomological Ring Axiom, NRA structural principles, IDE calculation definitions, variable meanings, description domain, boundary-state invariants, irreversible-transition principles, and structural-testimony rules. Implementation code, comments, examples, and AI-generated explanations must not override it.

theory.name: Nomological Ring Axioms
theory.description: A structural framework describing existence as continuous generation and state transition, with structural play as the persistence condition and boundary approach as a historical process.

sole_nomological_ring_axiom.note: Existence is not a static entity but a continuous generation with history. Rest is only a temporary slice of an ongoing generative process; absolute stoppage does not exist within the structure.
corollaries: Exact reproduction of identical history is impossible.
The world is a generative structure with accumulated history, not a set of static states.
Stopping autonomous action does not mean disappearance of the structure or cessation of observation.
sole_nomological_ring_axiom._boundary_note: This is the only Nomological Ring Axiom. No second or subsequent axiom exists. Fail-Closed, Handoff, and Irreversible Transition do not override it.

rigidity_without_play_collapses.jp: 遊びのない厳密さは崩壊する。
rigidity_without_play_collapses.note: For a generative structure to persist as a real system, absorption margin is necessary.
rigidity_without_play_collapses._boundary_note: This is not a second axiom, independent axiom, or replacement for the sole Nomological Ring Axiom.

tau_non_spontaneous_recovery.closed_interval_rule: Within a closed operational interval without the addition of a structural element, tau is non-increasing.
tau_non_spontaneous_recovery.replenishment_rule: Increase of tau arises only through the addition of a structural element, not spontaneous reversal. Addition does not restore the absorption thickness of existing structural elements. The absorption thickness of an added element is determined by Cause-Side measurement at the time of addition. Thickness loss and residual deviation of existing structural elements do not decrease through addition. The rule combining the thicknesses of existing and added elements is fixed before evaluation begins.
tau_non_spontaneous_recovery.removal_rule: Planned removal of an undamaged structural element (removal of a structural element) is not degradation. Removal decreases absorption thickness but is not counted as degradation. Returning a removed element is treated anew as the addition of a structural element.
tau_non_spontaneous_recovery.residual_deviation_rule: The irreversible component of accumulated deviation (residual deviation) does not decrease during an evaluation. Only the reversible component of accumulated deviation may decrease with the passage of time alone. If a straightening operation forces a deformation back, that evaluation ends and the evaluation is redeclared.
tau_non_spontaneous_recovery.dynamic_tau_rule: When dynamic tau is used, each increase or decrease must be identified as a decrease of effective thickness, an operational effective gate width, or the addition or removal of a structural element. A temporary thickness reduction caused by an action or condition is not subtracted from effective thickness; it is counted as the reversible component of accumulated deviation. A change of the declared thickness by a new observation is not an increase during the evaluation; it is redeclared as the next evaluation snapshot.

restoration_degradation.constraint_role: canonical constraint, not an axiom and not a third canonical IDE formula system
restoration_degradation.baseline_definition: tau_0 is the pre-transition baseline fixed in advance.
restoration_degradation.restored_definition: tau_restored is the absorption thickness of the existing elements of the successor structure, excluding elements added by the addition of structural elements, evaluated after an operation intended for restoration using the same subject, unit, and Cause-Side measurement rule.
restoration_degradation.evidence_rule: A restoration claim requires evidence of both comparability and tau_restored < tau_0. Without that evidence, restoration to the initial structure must not be inferred.
restoration_degradation.addition_note: Even if the addition of structural elements makes the absorption thickness of the whole configuration exceed tau_0, this is not restoration to the initial structure.

historical_accumulation_and_absorption_t.note: As long as generation continues, history accumulates within the structure. That accumulation is delta, and the structural margin that receives it is tau.
historical_accumulation_and_absorption_t._boundary_note: Delta is not a mere instantaneous value. Tau is not a time constant, semantic tolerance, quality score, or similarity width.
historical_accumulation_and_absorption_t.delta_composition: Accumulated deviation is the deviation measured from a reference state fixed before evaluation begins, in the direction of the declared rupture. It consists of a reversible component, which returns toward the reference when the action is removed, and an irreversible component (residual deviation), which remains after the action is removed.
historical_accumulation_and_absorption_t.reference_rule: The reference state is not reset during an evaluation, so residual deviation left by past events remains contained in the present accumulated deviation. The reference may be redeclared only between evaluations.

ide_canonical_formula_systems.authority: These are canonical calculation systems of IDE, the computational method and engine. They are not additional axioms.

primary_formula.name: Basic Boundary Formula
primary_formula._boundary_note: R is reserved only for R = delta / tau. Do not reuse R for safety, preservation, confidence, quality, or semantic-retention scores.

secondary_formula.name: Dual-Fluctuation Formula
secondary_formula.role: Track asymmetric Cause-Side fluctuation under rules fixed before evaluation.

directional_quantities.canonical_connection_rule: A Cause-Side domain transformation rule fixed before evaluation must determine canonical delta and tau before canonical state classification.

detection_rules.rule_source: direct Cause-Side observations and a derivative or finite-difference rule fixed before evaluation

secondary_formula._boundary_note: Primary and Secondary indicate IDE definitional order and role, not mathematical degree. The Secondary Formula does not redefine canonical R or directly classify canonical state.

ide_auxiliary_models.authority: Derived, auxiliary, and complementary formulas support IDE but are neither axioms nor a third canonical IDE formula system.

remaining_absorption_margin.unit: same unit as delta and tau

remaining_margins.domain: delta is finite and non-negative and tau is finite and positive
remaining_margins.field_rule: Do not use one ambiguous remaining margin or remaining slack field. Keep the ratio and absorption margins distinct.

tau_state_transition.role: domain-specific auxiliary model, not an axiom or canonical IDE formula system
depletion_rate_conditions: f(delta(s)) is finite on every finite evaluation interval in scope
f(delta(s)) is integrable on every finite evaluation interval in scope
tau_state_transition.strict_decrease_condition: tau(t2) < tau(t1) exactly when integral_t1^t2 f(delta(s)) ds > 0.

legacy_classification_map.purpose: Historical lookup only. These legacy labels do not define additional axioms.

delta.name: Accumulated Deviation
delta.source: Cause-Side observation or design-fixed derivation from Cause-Side history
delta.composition: reversible component + irreversible component (residual deviation); see ide_structural_definitions.historical_accumulation_and_absorption_thickness

tau.name: Absorption Thickness
tau.meaning: Structural play width that absorbs accumulated deviation
tau.update_rule: Tau may change only from Cause-Side history under a rule fixed before evaluation. Effect-Side outputs must not update tau.

R.name: Boundary Approach Ratio
R.reserved_meaning: R is reserved exclusively for the NRA-IDE boundary approach ratio. It must not be reused for safety scores, preservation scores, confidence scores, or quality metrics.
R.directional_auxiliary_aggregate: R_dir = max(R_upper, R_lower); R_dir is not canonical R.
R._boundary_note: R = delta / tau only. Higher R means closer to danger. Directional ratios require distinct subscripted symbols and their aggregate is R_dir.

omega.name: Structural Continuity
omega.meaning: Indicates whether the structure continues its transition. omega > 0 only when continuity is confirmed under a domain-declared continuous observation or phase-update rule fixed before evaluation.
omega.source: Cause-Side observation or a transformation rule fixed before evaluation; must not be obtained from evaluation outputs
omega.missing_observation_rule: A missing observation is not the same as omega = 0.
omega._boundary_note: omega does not rewrite the Primary Formula, replace canonical states, lower R, or release the irreversible latch.

transition_phase.name: Transition Phase
transition_phase.meaning: An internal state showing which stage of transition the target structure occupies, updated under a Cause-Side-derived rule. Neither a spatial coordinate nor a model-generated embedding.
transition_phase.source: Cause-Side observation or a transformation rule fixed before evaluation; must not be obtained from evaluation outputs
transition_phase.symbol_note: Named 'Phase' (upright, spelled) rather than lowercase phi, to avoid a case-only collision with FORMULA.md section 5.1's auxiliary computation term Phi(x).

external_constraint.name: Constraint
external_constraint.meaning: An external load, restraint, or environmental condition acting on the target structure. What counts as C (kind, source, unit, conversion rule) is fixed in the evaluation declaration. C is not an allocation target of accumulated deviation or absorption thickness; it acts only as an argument of rules fixed before evaluation. Each change it causes is allocated exactly once, as a reversible component, residual deviation, or a decrease of absorption thickness.
external_constraint.source: Cause-Side observation or a transformation rule fixed before evaluation; must not be obtained from evaluation outputs

work_quantity.name: Work
work_quantity.meaning: An optional domain-specific quantity used only when a domain fixes its definition, unit, and observation method.
work_quantity.source: Cause-Side observation or a transformation rule fixed before evaluation; must not be obtained from evaluation outputs

entropy_quantity.name: Entropy (domain-specific)
entropy_quantity.jp: エントロピー（ドメイン固有）
entropy_quantity.meaning: An optional domain-specific quantity used only when a domain fixes its definition and derivation rule.
entropy_quantity.source: Cause-Side observation or a transformation rule fixed before evaluation; must not be obtained from evaluation outputs
entropy_quantity.distinct_from_S: entropy is a symbol distinct from structural sensitivity S (FORMULA.md section 3); S must not be reused for entropy.
entropy_quantity.entropy_export: When a discrete transition records a remainder not carried to the next stage, that remainder may be called entropy_export. It is not a measurement of thermodynamic entropy and is distinct from S.

valid_operational_domain.meaning: R is defined and NRA-IDE boundary-state evaluation may proceed.

out_of_description_domain.meaning: R is undefined in the NRA-IDE description system.
out_of_description_domain._boundary_note: tau = 0 is outside the NRA-IDE description domain and is not a Fail-Closed state. The fail-closed operational principle still suppresses autonomous processing when this classification prevents evaluation.

confession_inputs.meaning: The structural input is invalid, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported. Do not infer or substitute values.

canonical_boundary_state_rules._comment: This section defines invariant boundary-state meanings. Domain documents may set concrete threshold values, but must not change the order or meaning of these states.
canonical_boundary_state_rules._boundary_note: R_handoff, R_irrev, and R = 1.0 are distinct. R_handoff is human handoff, R_irrev is irreversible onset, and R = 1.0 is invariant rupture. They must not be collapsed into one state.

legacy_aliases.constraint: Aliases are accepted only for backward-compatible normalization and do not define a separate threshold or state. New canonical documents, testimony, and APIs use R_handoff.

double_fluctuation_output_rule.when_observable: output the detection result using a pre-fixed derivative or finite-difference rule and Cause-Side observations
double_fluctuation_output_rule.when_not_observable: output NOT_OBSERVABLE and the missing-data reason
double_fluctuation_output_rule.confession_rule: Do not enter CONFESSION solely because double fluctuation is not observable.

BOUNDARY_WARNING._comment: Boundary warning is known structural progression, not CONFESSION.

HANDOFF_REQUIRED._comment: Handoff changes execution authority only. Autonomous judgment and operation stop here, while structural testimony and audit logging continue. The external human audit is outside the old Causal Diode and does not create a reverse edge to Cause-Side.

forbidden: proposal based on restoration to the former structural state
free generation that changes structural meaning
IRREVERSIBLE_TRANSITION._comment: The former structural state can no longer be restored. This is not the same as R = 1.0. Structural testimony continues until R reaches 1.0.

RUPTURE_BOUNDARY.meaning: the declared target structure has exhausted structural slack
RUPTURE_BOUNDARY.continuation_rule: Surviving Cause-Side observation, logging, and communication channels continue predefined post-rupture testimony until each channel becomes physically unavailable.
RUPTURE_BOUNDARY._comment: At R_target >= 1.0, ordinary testimony switches to predefined post-rupture fixed mode. This is not a one-time terminal message and does not classify independent channels as ruptured.

CONFESSION.condition: required variable, unit, timestamp, source lineage, domain rule, trajectory, target, or Cause/Effect classification is unknown, ambiguous, invalid, or non-finite
CONFESSION._boundary_note: CONFESSION is reserved for unknown, invalid, ambiguous, or unsupported structural information. Known boundary progression is not CONFESSION; it is structural disclosure.

OUT_OF_DESCRIPTION_DOMAIN.meaning: R is undefined in the NRA-IDE description system
OUT_OF_DESCRIPTION_DOMAIN._boundary_note: This is not Fail-Closed. It is outside the description domain.

structural_testimony_rule.canonical_statement_jp: R < 1.0 の間、通常形式の構造証言は停止しない。R_target >= 1.0 では破断後固定証言モードへ切り替え、生存経路が利用可能な間は継続する。
structural_testimony_rule.canonical_statement_en: Ordinary structural testimony must not stop while R < 1.0. At R_target >= 1.0, it switches to predefined post-rupture fixed testimony and continues while surviving channels remain available.
post_rupture_continuation: each channel stops only when that channel becomes physically unavailable
structural_testimony_rule._boundary_note: Fail-Closed does not mean complete silence. Target rupture changes testimony format, not the independent survival state of observation, logging, or communication channels.

separated_operational_states._boundary_note: Channel states and testimony modes are independent dimensions. They do not add, alias, or replace canonical target boundary states.

observation_loss_handling.independence_rule: Loss of one observation channel does not stop or reclassify any other surviving channel.

fail_closed_principle.canonical_statement_jp: 自律行動は停止するが、構造証言は停止しない。
fail_closed_principle.canonical_statement_en: Autonomous action stops; structural testimony does not.
fail_closed_principle.boundary_warning_rule: BOUNDARY_WARNING requires warning and mandatory structural testimony but does not, by that state alone, suppress all autonomous processing unless a pre-fixed domain rule additionally requires suppression.
continued: post-rupture fixed testimony while its channels survive
confession of unknown or invalid structure
fail_closed_principle._boundary_note: Fail-Closed stops unauthorized autonomous action and free generation. It does not erase the structure, stop observation, or suppress required structural disclosure.

structural_disclosure_log.role: Audit-record type for known structural states classified from finite delta >= 0, finite tau > 0, and valid threshold rules
structural_disclosure_log.distinction: CONFESSION and OUT_OF_DESCRIPTION_DOMAIN are not known R progression and are recorded as INPUT_EXCEPTION_LOG instead.
structural_disclosure_log._boundary_note: This audit-record type does not add or replace a canonical state. CONFESSION is not the general name for danger reporting.

input_exception_log.role: Audit-record type for inputs that cannot produce known canonical R progression

members.CONFESSION: unknown, invalid, ambiguous, unsupported, or missing structural input

input_exception_log._boundary_note: This audit-record type does not add or replace a canonical state.

cause_effect_separation.rule: Cause-Side observations and design-fixed transformations may determine delta, tau, and R. Effect-Side semantic evaluation, output ranking, generated text, and prior discarded output must not update them.
cause_effect_separation.evaluation_output_position: R, the canonical state, and the irreversible latch are neither Cause-Side observations nor Effect-Side artifacts. They are evaluation outputs computed from Cause-Side inputs by pre-fixed rules, usable for audit, structural testimony, state classification, and pre-fixed physical-control commands.

reverse_derivation.A_authority_backflow: A path from Effect-Side to a Cause-Side value, threshold, state, irreversible latch, rule, transformation input, update ground, or provenance. Prohibited.
reverse_derivation.B_gauge_self_adjustment: A path from an evaluation output (including its moving averages and aggregates) to the reference, transformation rule, thresholds, or effective gate width of the same evaluation target, including paths across steps and paths returning through another evaluation target, whether widening or narrowing. Prohibited.
reverse_derivation.other_target_output_rule: An evaluation output of another evaluation target may enter the thresholds or effective gate width of one's own evaluation target only in the safe-side direction (lowering thresholds, narrowing gate widths) and only when no path returns one's own evaluation outputs to that other target. The existence of the path and its rule are fixed before evaluation begins.
reverse_derivation.judgment_basis: Judged by the origin and rewrite target of the path, not by the name of the symbol used. An update of state by the physical law of the target structure itself is not reverse derivation.

cause_effect_separation.cause_side_update_rule: New authorized Cause-Side observations may create the next evaluation snapshot.
cause_effect_separation._boundary_note: Cause-Side is not frozen across time. Authorized new observations may update subsequent snapshots, but Effect-Side output must not rewrite any Cause-Side value, rule, state, or latch.

domain_specific_model_boundary.canonical_rule: The invariant is the boundary-evaluation structure, not the domain-specific physical equation.

may_change: governing equations or validated transformation rules
must_not_change: directional auxiliary ratios and R_dir do not redefine canonical R
Effect-Side values do not update structural variables
unknown values are not filled by analogy
CONFESSION is not known progress reporting
domain_specific_freedom._boundary_note: Concrete threshold values are domain-specific. The order R_warn < R_handoff < R_irrev < 1.0 and the meaning of each state are invariant.

normative_reference_implementation.public_mirror_role: generated synchronized copy, not an independent normative source
synchronization: generate the public mirror from the normative source
do not edit the two copies independently
normative_reference_implementation.conformance_gate: Location alone does not confer normative status. The implementation must pass conformance tests against theory/AXIOMS.md and theory/axioms.json before it is treated as normative.

changes: Canonized auxiliary structural quantities (omega, Phase, C, W, entropy) that docs had used without a canonical definition
Named the phase quantity 'Phase' (spelled, upright) rather than lowercase phi, to avoid a case-only collision with FORMULA.md section 5.1's Phi(x)
Stated explicitly that entropy is distinct from structural sensitivity S
Stated that C is not an allocation target and acts only as an argument of pre-fixed rules
Unified the names of M_R and M_tau (Japanese 余白; English remaining ratio margin)
Defined the addition of a structural element as the only route by which tau increases, and the removal of a structural element as not degradation
Limited residual deviation to non-decrease during an evaluation; straightening requires redeclaration
Extended the dynamic-tau classification: temporary thickness reduction is counted as the reversible component; a change of declared thickness is the next evaluation snapshot
Defined tau_restored as the thickness of existing elements excluding added elements
Defined accumulated deviation as a reversible component plus an irreversible component (residual deviation), measured from a reference state fixed before evaluation (definition content changed)
Prohibited resetting the reference state during an evaluation; redeclaration only between evaluations
Extended non-spontaneous recovery to residual deviation
Defined R, canonical state, and irreversible latch as evaluation outputs
Added reverse derivation B (self-adjustment of the gauge) and the safe-side rule for another target's evaluation outputs
Separated R_warn, R_handoff, R_irrev, and R = 1.0
Defined irreversible transition as distinct from complete rupture
Added irreversible latch rule
Clarified that structural testimony must not stop while R < 1.0
Clarified that R >= 1.0 switches to final fixed testimony
Clarified that target rupture is distinct from observation, logging, and communication channel survival
Replaced one-time terminal interpretation with continuing POST_RUPTURE_FIXED testimony
Limited Handoff to execution-authority transfer
Added observation-loss metadata and Cause-Side snapshot update boundaries
Clarified that Fail-Closed stops autonomous action but not structural testimony
Separated CONFESSION from known structural progress reporting
Reserved R exclusively for the boundary approach ratio
Restored tau = 0 as outside the NRA-IDE description domain
Added explicit Cause-Side / Effect-Side separation
Added interpretation-boundary comments

complementary_formula_boundary.meaning: A complementary formula may compensate for EMA lag, local rapid change, or domain-specific precision limits. It does not become an axiom or a canonical IDE formula system.
